name: host_admin
description: Request a change to the server through the root host helper, or read host status. Every change waits for an administrator's approval on the Host Admin page; a background notice wakes this chat when it is decided and finished.

action.description: status reads host status now; request files host_action with host_args for approval; check reads one request by request_id.

host_action.description: request only: the change to ask for.

host_args.description: request only: file_write {path, content}; host_revert {request_id}; unit_restart {unit}; container_restart {container}; packages_upgrade and noop {}.

request_id.description: check only: the request id a request returned.
